Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea

Class UmbilicalElectricalCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.subsea.UmbilicalElectricalCalculator
public final class UmbilicalElectricalCalculator extends Object
Electrical screening calculations for umbilical power, signal and fibre-optic elements.

Three-phase power cables are solved as a distributed-parameter line (exact hyperbolic two-port), which includes the cable charging current that dominates long step-out distances, with skin effect on the conductor resistance (IEC 60287-1-1) and a coaxial capacitance model of the screened core. Conductor resistance is copper with a linear temperature coefficient. Proximity effect, armour/screen losses and dielectric loss are not included; results are screening values.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
